Tuesday Recovery Ride

Round Rock, TX · Gattis School Rd · Road

No-dropBeginner friendly

Tuesday Recovery Ride is a road group ride in Round Rock, TX. It rolls every Tuesday at 6:30 pm from Blur Cycleworks. About 17 miles, 14–15 mph, easy and mostly flat. No-drop.

For visitors

Helmet and rear light required; arrive 15 minutes early; sign the shop's waiver once each calendar year. No ear buds or headphones. Carry what you need to fix a flat. Tri bikes are fine if you're comfortable in a group.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:30 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 14–15 mph: steady — you'll breathe hard on the hills. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Tuesday Recovery Ride group ride

Blur Cycleworks' easy Tuesday-night ride out of Round Rock, 17 miles at 14 to 15 mph. The shop says it's no-drop, beginners are encouraged, and it's a good way to learn group riding or move from the trainer to the road.
